info.title: Argos Premium CI API
info.description: Preview contract. premium-ci.enabled=false until complete acceptance #467. Bearer machine key required on every call. Unknown query parameters are rejected. No cookie/admin/report-token substitution; no anonymous fallback. Responses and errors are private no-store. Body <=8192 bytes. Private details-v1 JSON exports are bounded to 65536 bytes. Verdicts require two comparable samples of the same admission. Publication clients are separate and cannot change the audit outcome.

CiError.description: Versioned #741 envelope. 400 invalid configuration/target, uniform 401 authentication, 403 scope/entitlement/proof, uniform 404 own resource unavailable, 409 intention conflict, 429 quota/rate, controlled 500/502/503/504. Unknown exceptions never expose raw diagnostics. Recover ambiguous POSTs with the original intention.
